entries.title: Exodus 6:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD said to Moses, "Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh. For with a strong hand he will let them go, and with a strong hand he will drive them out of his land."

entries.title: Exodus 6:2
segments: And God spoke to Moses and said to him: "I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 6:3
segments: "I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty, but [by] My name LORD I was not known to them.

entries.title: Exodus 6:4
segments: "I have also established My covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, in which they were strangers.

entries.title: Exodus 6:5
segments: "And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered My covenant.

entries.title: Exodus 6:6
segments: "Therefore say to the children of Israel: 'I [am] the LORD; I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, I will rescue you from their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with great judgments.

entries.title: Exodus 6:7
segments: 'I will take you as My people, and I will be your God. Then you shall know that I [am] the LORD your God who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 6:8
segments: 'And I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; and I will give it to you [as] a heritage: I [am] the LORD.'"

entries.title: Exodus 6:9
segments: So Moses spoke thus to the children of Israel; but they did not heed Moses, because of anguish of spirit and cruel bondage.

entries.title: Exodus 6:10
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 6:11
segments: "Go in, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the children of Israel go out of his land."

entries.title: Exodus 6:12
segments: And Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, "The children of Israel have not heeded me. How then shall Pharaoh heed me, for I [am] of uncircumcised lips?"

entries.title: Exodus 6:13
segments: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, and gave them a command for the children of Israel and for Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 6:14
segments: ¶These [are] the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, [were] Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These are the families of Reuben.

entries.title: Exodus 6:15
segments: And the sons of Simeon [were] Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These [are] the families of Simeon.

entries.title: Exodus 6:16
segments: These [are] the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. And the years of the life of Levi [were] one hundred and thirty-seven.

entries.title: Exodus 6:17
segments: The sons of Gershon [were] Libni and Shimi according to their families.

entries.title: Exodus 6:18
segments: And the sons of Kohath [were] Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. And the years of the life of Kohath [were] one hundred and thirty-three.

entries.title: Exodus 6:19
segments: The sons of Merari [were] Mahali and Mushi. These [are] the families of Levi according to their generations.

entries.title: Exodus 6:20
segments: Now Amram took for himself Jochebed, his father's sister, as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. And the years of the life of Amram [were] one hundred and thirty-seven.

entries.title: Exodus 6:21
segments: The sons of Izhar [were] Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.

entries.title: Exodus 6:22
segments: And the sons of Uzziel [were] Mishael, Elzaphan, and Zithri.

entries.title: Exodus 6:23
segments: Aaron took to himself Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon, as wife; and she bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

entries.title: Exodus 6:24
segments: And the sons of Korah [were] Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These are the families of the Korahites.

entries.title: Exodus 6:25
segments: Eleazar, Aaron's son, took for himself one of the daughters of Putiel as wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These [are] the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites according to their families.

entries.title: Exodus 6:26
segments: These [are the same] Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, "Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies."

entries.title: Exodus 6:27
segments: These [are] the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These [are the same] Moses and Aaron.

entries.title: Exodus 6:28
segments: And it came to pass, on the day the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

entries.title: Exodus 6:29
segments: that the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, "I [am] the LORD. Speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to you."

entries.title: Exodus 6:30
segments: But Moses said before the LORD, "Behold, I [am] of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh heed me?"
